_meta.title: Bottom-posted reply below an over-cap quoted thread (THE MAIL-19 regression case)
_meta.covers: design A15 / §7.6 v4: quoted-history intake cap shape — head+tail, not head-only
_meta.expect: Threads onto the entity; the reply text ("Approved. Please proceed with the milestone payment") is present in the stored body_text even though the body exceeds the 128 KiB intake cap and the reply sits BELOW the whole quoted thread. Pre-A15 head-only truncation would have discarded it entirely. Exactly one "[truncated at intake: N characters omitted here]" marker appears, with N = raw length minus the 128 KiB budget.
